rows.text: Ever since Aquila's hundred eyes lost their light, the Regulation Seal has become the sole method of timekeeping in Amphoreus. Each day is equally divided into five periods according to human habit and behavior, and time pushes the pentagon clock face to slowly turn. This dial not only guards daily routines but also reveals underlying laws and foretells future events. Over time, this timekeeping system has synchronized with the biological clocks of many citizens, for they naturally wake at the Entry Hour and fall asleep at the Curtain-Fall Hour.
